My Cousin was over yesterday and insisted on buying our pizza from a local shop. To my dismay they were only a pickup, and so we argued over the value of local vs the name brand shops (Pizza Hut, Pizza Pizza, Domino's) as I was keen on delivery. He eventually wore me down and after we placed the telephone order we headed out to pick up our pizza and wings. The order was about ten dollars more than usual. They threw in some pop and dipping sauce at no charge but I still felt like it might've been a money grab. Once we got home and unloaded the meal is was evident there was something to this. At the first bite I was immediately brought back to my childhood when I actually, genuinely liked pizza. The crust was perfectly firm, the sauce tasted like fresh tomatoes, the mushrooms were rough cut and fresh, and the pepperoni was proudly home made. I even ate the crust. I never eat the crust. From now on I'm ordering from a local pizza shop and if I don't have the money, I won't even order pizza. Shit was delicious.
